question: INS Tamal, a state-of-the-art stealth multi-role frigate, which was commissioned by the Indian Navy on 1 July 2025, was built in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **INS Tamal** is a state-of-the-art **stealth multi-role frigate** that was commissioned by the **Indian Navy** on **1 July 2025**.
 
• The vessel was constructed in **Russia** at the **Yantar Shipyard** located in **Kaliningrad**. This shipyard has a long-standing history of building high-quality naval vessels for the **Indian Navy**.
 
• The construction of this frigate is part of a larger deal signed between **India** and **Russia** in **2016** for the procurement of **four** additional **Project 1135.6** (also known as **Talwar-class**) frigates.
